D.t: Josh Green leads by 36.1 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 165,360 votes; a one point swing is about 2,289 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +26.8 and D +45.4. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Honolulu, a projected net 107,363 votes; Hawaii, a projected net 27,905 votes; Maui, a projected net 22,609 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Josh Green runs furthest behind in Kauai, Hawaii. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 28% of voters, 50 to 50, where a 5 point gain is worth 1.39 points; Immigration voters, 9% of voters, 43 to 57, where a 5 point gain is worth 0.43 points.
The forecast's worst groups for Josh Green: Immigration voters 43 to 57, White voters 50 to 50, 2024 voters who skipped 2022 65 to 35. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
Money: Raised $313K against $3.7M for Josh Green.

R.t: Gary Cordery trails by 36.1 and wins 0% of simulations. Closing it takes about 82,680 voters switching sides, or 165,360 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +45.4 and D +26.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
